decisions.reason: The dashboard-specific requirements in message 36 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the interface-streamlining change adds no further dashboard-state change.
Simplifying the model interface does not change the required Canadian tax treatment, CCA classes, or modeled tax effects.
The source does not change assumption annotations, reference sources, or the policy for unavailable inputs.
The general interface-streamlining decision does not alter the confirmed debt/equity structure, financing rate, tranche structure, or refinement trigger.
The source does not change capex estimates, assumption bases, included shared costs, or their required line-item presentation.
Streamlining the model interface does not change the eight-site configuration, site-list source, or site-level modeling basis.
The source does not alter the operating-cost range, its source, or the exclusion of the appendix amount from the complete network model.
A simpler and more auditable interface does not logically modify the requirement that formulas, worksheet links, and calculated outputs remain correct and credible.
The source does not change the DSCR or equity-IRR thresholds or the rule against DSCR-only sizing.
The source reinforces clear communication of viability and bankability but does not change the existing user-funded and PPP scenario comparison or its required finding.
The interface-streamlining change does not alter source-data verification, primary reference sources, or the directional role of the demand analysis.
The source requests a simpler presentation and interface but does not necessarily change the integrated three-statement structure or the underlying financial-engine basis.
